description: Delegation chain verification vectors (Specification 9.3). Each credential's delegationChain links embed the signed grant they came from (parentCredential). Evaluate verify_delegation_chain at `now`: `expected` is null for a valid chain, or the reason code. All identities are did:key, so every key resolves offline. Full credential verification at `now` must succeed exactly when `expected` is null.

cases.name: valid_two_hop
cases.note: root -> a -> b, each step narrows

cases.name: forged_grant_signature
cases.note: the root grant carries a signature that is not the root's

cases.name: tampered_root_grant
cases.note: the root grant's action set was edited after signing

cases.name: tampered_intermediate_grant
cases.note: the a -> b grant was edited after signing

cases.name: widened_leaf_action
cases.note: a's own credential is broader than the root grant on action

cases.name: widened_leaf_target
cases.note: a's own credential is broader than the root grant on target

cases.name: widened_leaf_resource
cases.note: a's own credential is broader than the root grant on resource

cases.name: widened_leaf_rate
cases.note: a's own credential is broader than the root grant on rate

cases.name: widened_intermediate_grant
cases.note: a re-delegates more actions than it was granted

cases.name: leaf_outlives_grant
cases.note: the leaf's validity runs past the grant's

cases.name: stolen_chain
cases.note: mallory presents b's chain under her own credential

cases.name: link_subject_not_delegatee
cases.note: the link names mallory but the grant names b

cases.name: grant_without_delegatee
cases.note: a grant that names no delegatee cannot be chained under

cases.name: link_without_signed_grant
cases.note: links that carry no signed grant cannot be verified

cases.name: parent_proof_binding_mismatch
cases.note: parentProofValue does not match the embedded grant's proof

cases.name: spend_within_cap
cases.note: b spends 15 under a cap of 20

cases.name: spend_over_cap
cases.note: b spends 30 under a cap of 20

cases.name: sub_grant_raises_cap
cases.note: a re-delegates with a higher cap than it was given

cases.name: inherited_cap_binds_leaf
cases.note: a's grant omits the policy, so the root's cap of 50 still binds b

cases.name: expired_grant
cases.note: the valid chain evaluated after its grants expired
